name: GRAND HARBOR GOLF AND BEACH CLUB

violations.text: Employee beverage container on a food preparation table or over/next to clean equipment/utensils.

Employee personal items stored in or above a food preparation area, food, clean equipment and utensils, or single-service items.
Purse on shelf with clean containers. Chef moved

Food stored in undrained ice.
Fresh mussels. In cookline cooler drawers. Advised to drain water

No handwashing sign or paper towels provided at a hand sink used by food employees.
Cook line paper towels and sign was posted

Plumbing system in disrepair.
Soda gun nozzle at servers area is not draining water. Nozzle is submerged in standing water. Maintenance arrived during inspection to look at nozzle

Raw fruits/vegetables not washed prior to preparation.
Employee cutting cucumbers. Manager spoke to employee

Unwashed fruits/vegetables stored with ready-to-eat food.
Cut avocados with whole sticker intact avocado. Chef moved cut avocado

Raw animal foods not properly separated from each other in holding unit based upon minimum required cooking temperature.
Raw ground beef over salmon in walk in

Time/temperature control for safety food cold held at greater than 41 degrees Fahrenheit.
blue cheese (49F - Cold Holding)
feta cheese (47F - Cold Holding)
In cooler less than 4 hours. Items were moved to rapid chill.
Chef moved to rapid chill

Vacuum breaker missing at hose bibb or on fitting/splitter added to hose bibb.
Mop sink
